# Synthetic S2 test inputs

Made for tests only; not the curated Clean run dataset and never shown in a demo.

- `inputs/request.pdf`: two-page request with a deadline, scope, and a specification list; the bid bond is not stated.
- `inputs/drawings/E-001.pdf`: one landscape page with a single-line diagram and a short panel note.
- `fixtures/supplier-prices.csv`: six priced items in the fixture format from `datasets/README.md`.

The PDFs were compiled with Typst 0.15.1 from sources kept in the session scratchpad; regenerate by editing and compiling again if the tests need different content.
